body: We are pleased to confirm the admission of your son Master Arjun Singh to Class IX, Section B for the academic session 2026–27.

Kindly visit the school office between 9:00 AM and 1:00 PM on any working day to complete the documentation. Please carry the original birth certificate, transfer certificate from the previous school, and three recent passport-size photographs.
We look forward to welcoming Arjun to the Khalsa International family.
